source_locator: Table 3 column 2, printed p. 63 / PDF p. 13; interpretation continues PDF p. 14
metric: convergence of log population deviation, conditional on regression controls
estimator: SUR with country and time effects
regression_controls: scientific knowledge and change in scientific knowledge
comparison_role: Population-recovery contextual check for comparable fixed-system experiments; separate from the wage benchmark. Not an intrinsic birth/death rate or a universal local acceptance range.
limitations: Log-population deviation is not identical to absolute population deviation; match the metric before comparing.
The source is an estimated cross-country historical regression, not a food-stock perturbation experiment.
Country and time controls and changing technology differ from a closed fixed-infrastructure local simulator.
No automatic application to 1337 tropical or tribal populations.
Table 3 column 3 gamma=-0.034 at T=30 gives a negative signed deviation factor; the monotone logarithmic half-life formula is inapplicable to that column.
The paper rounds the column-2 population interpretation to about eleven years; do not borrow the approximately ten-year wage calculation.
